insight.statement: instagram currently leads mature-post views with 118.0 average views across 1 post(s); treat this as directional only until matched creative samples accumulate.

leadingIndicators.sourceLagNotice: Buffer refreshes post metrics daily; values can lag the social network by about 24 hours.

rewards.evidence: Buffer API snapshot 2026-07-28 and live status readback confirmed six YouTube/X reel pairs sent with retained video assets for largest-silver-producing-countries-in-the-world, ai-tools-for-small-business-marketing-in-2026, silver-reserve-plan-what-it-is-and-how-it-works, silver-recycling-and-scrap-recovery-market, chatgpt-for-small-business-owners-beginners-guide, and how-to-start-using-ai-in-your-small-business.

Buffer live status now reconciles local scheduled checkpoint logs against authoritative scheduled/sending/sent readback, and tests/buffer-log-reconciliation.test.mjs prevents the stale scheduled-state bug from silently recurring.

Live HEAD verification returned 200 for five sampled shipped blog URLs, blog/posts.json, sitemap.xml, and both YouTube/X MP4 media URLs for largest-silver-producing-countries-in-the-world; the six distributed reels all had release-qa readyForPosting=true.

penalties.evidence: Local .buffer-*-scheduled.json checkpoints still showed six July 27 YouTube/X posts as scheduled until the July 28 live Buffer status replay reconciled them to sent.

An out-of-sandbox replay on July 29, 2026 reproduced the deferred writer failure for ai-for-customer-service-small-business-how-to-set-it-up: the raw article stayed under the 8-12 H2 requirement and included uncited named-source claims, so build-post returned write-deferred again.

Expected July 28 queue slug ai-for-customer-service-small-business-how-to-set-it-up remained in public/blog/research/2026-07-28-pending.json on July 29, 2026, and its live URL still returned 404 while the other three queue slugs were live.
